campaign.locked: Win the level before this one to open it.
menu.artAlt: A tiny tribe village on a round island diorama
howto.goal.head: The goal
howto.goal.text: Your tribe lives on a small round world. Destroy every rival Hearth, or meet the match goal shown at the top right, while your own Hearth stands. Water kills: anyone on land that sinks into the sea drowns.
howto.grow.head: Grow the village
howto.grow.text: Settlers gather wood and stone on their own. Press {key:buildDwelling} to place Dwellings near your Hearth; full Dwellings breed new followers. More followers open new buildings: the Watchtower and the Warden Lodge at 10.
howto.spells.head: Mana and spells
howto.spells.text: Followers pray for mana. The slider at the top left splits them between Spells and Training. Pick a spell in the top bar (or Z, X, C, V, B, N) and click a target for your Shaper. Right click a spell to auto-charge it; {key:cancelCast} takes back a cast.
howto.army.head: Your army
howto.army.text: Click a lodge to train Wardens (melee), Firecallers (ranged), Chanters (convert rivals) or Shades (disguise and sabotage). Drag a box to select, right click to move, {key:attackMove} then click to attack-move, {key:retreat} to retreat, {key:garrison} to garrison a Watchtower.
howto.camera.head: Camera and keys
howto.camera.text: Wheel to zoom, {key:rotateLeft} and {key:rotateRight} to rotate, arrow keys or the screen edge to pan, {key:toggleMap} for the whole world, click the minimap to jump there. {key:pauseMenu} or Esc pauses, {key:photoMode} is photo mode, {key:healthBars} cycles the health bars, {key:help} shows every key in play. The {key:speedDown} and {key:speedUp} keys slow down or speed up a single player match, F5 quick saves, F9 quick loads, and {key:briefing} rereads a campaign level briefing. {key:lastAlert} jumps to the latest attack (or click its note), and the {key:idleTroops} key selects the next idle troops. Keys can be changed in Settings.
howto.together.head: Play together
howto.together.text: Two computers on one home network can share a match. The host computer serves the game with npm run serve -- --lan and both open the address it prints. One picks Play together, hosts and reads out the room code; the other types it and joins. Play against each other, as one team against the AI, or through the campaign side by side. If a computer drops out it rejoins on its own; if it does not come back, the AI plays its tribe. The replay of a shared match plays back on either computer.
howto.start.head: Where to start
howto.start.text: Play the Campaign first: each level teaches one idea. In Skirmish, start with one easy rival. Keep your Shaper safe, and remember the land is a weapon: Raise Land builds ground, Erode and Quake sink it under your enemies.
menu.tagline: Shape the land. Lead your tribe. Keep them out of the sea.

spellTip.bolt: Strikes a small spot hard and knocks people back. Hits harder downhill.
spellTip.call: Brings up to 4 wild people near the target into your tribe.
spellTip.hornets: A swarm stings people in a small area for 8 s and sends them running in panic.
spellTip.veil: Hides up to 10 of your units near the target from other tribes for 60 s, or until they attack.
spellTip.ward: Shields up to 6 of your units from damage and knockback for 120 s. Lightning breaks it; water still drowns.
spellTip.raise_land: Raises a ridge of land from the Shaper toward the target, even out of the sea.
spellTip.lightning: A narrow strike strong enough to kill a Shaper. It sets the spot burning.
spellTip.beguile: Up to 8 enemy units near the target fight for you for 40 s. They go back if your Shaper dies.
spellTip.whirlwind: A whirlwind wanders off from the target for 12 s, flinging people and wearing down buildings.
spellTip.mire: A bog that swallows the first 10 enemy units to stand in it, for up to 90 s. Never a Shaper.
spellTip.flatten: Levels the land around the target to its average height, kept above the sea.
spellTip.quake: Scars the land in a wide circle, wrecks buildings and makes people panic.
spellTip.erode: Sinks the land around the target toward the sea over 10 s, drowning what stands there.
spellTip.firerain: 30 burning stones fall over a wide area for 8 s, hitting units and buildings.
spellTip.wraith: Summons a flying hunter that kills the nearest enemy unit once a second, up to 40, for 200 s. Never a Shaper.
spellTip.volcano: Raises a volcano: lava burns the area for 20 s, rocks fly and the land stays scarred.
spellTip.sanctuary: Your units in the area heal quickly for 10 s.
spellTip.deluge: A wave bursts from the ground, flings people outward and sinks the land a little, so shores flood.
